messages.content: Hey it's me again. Insurance denied the test strips AGAIN. This is the second time this month. What do I do?

I see that in your chart. Timing is rough, especially twice in one month. I can't handle the insurance side—that's gotta go through your provider or directly with your insurance company. What I can do: escalate to our nurse to make sure we document this for your provider and talk through your options. Want me to do that?
Yeah ok. But can you also get me samples or something while they sort it out?
I can't authorize samples—that's between you, your provider, and your pharmacy. But the nurse can advise on it. Let me get them looped in. Fair warning: median response is about 31 hours.
I know. Not ideal. In the meantime, if you've got strips left, keep testing. Anything that concerns you, flag it when the nurse calls.
Got it. Get me that nurse.
Done. They'll reach out within 31 hours. We'll check in next week too.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
